snippet.title: Train Door is A HUGE PROBLEM! Vande Bharat Auto Door Close Case in India! #shorts
snippet.description:
Kanpur Train Farewell Turns Into Costly Vande Bharat Ride as Automatic Doors Close

A routine visit to see off relatives turned into an unexpected train journey for a group at Kanpur Central after the automatic doors of the Banaras–New Delhi Vande Bharat Express closed before they could get off.

The incident occurred on November 15 aboard train number 22415. The visitors had entered the coaches to help family members with luggage and seating. However, they remained inside when the doors shut and the train departed, leaving them travelling without valid journey tickets.

The group eventually got off at Etawah, around 139 kilometres from Kanpur. Reports described anxious visitors approaching railway staff after realising they could no longer return to the platform. What was meant to be a brief farewell had become an unplanned intercity trip.

According to North Central Railway’s chief public relations officer, the subsequent inspection identified 12 adults and one child travelling without valid tickets. Railway authorities recovered ₹36,140 in prescribed fares and penalties. Some initial reports described the incident as involving 12 people and rounded the collection to ₹36,000.

The distinction matters: the charge was for unauthorised travel, rather than simply being present when the doors closed. Railway officials have urged visitors to carry valid platform tickets and avoid entering coaches to see off relatives. A platform ticket does not authorise a train journey.

For Indian families accustomed to helping relatives settle into their seats, the incident highlights how that familiar routine can go wrong when visitors remain aboard until departure on trains with automatic doors.

snippet.title: Train Brake FAILS & It Runs 463 KM! SCARY Vande Bharat Case in India #shorts
snippet.description:
Empty Vande Bharat Travels 463 km With Coach Brakes Isolated, Probe Ordered

An empty Vande Bharat train travelled approximately 463 kilometres with its coach brakes reportedly isolated, prompting South Eastern Railway to order an investigation. The incident occurred on October 24 during a transfer from Hatia in Jharkhand towards Jhansi in Uttar Pradesh, but became widely reported in November. No passengers were aboard the rake.

The train was being hauled by a freight locomotive rather than operating as a regular Vande Bharat passenger service. Its coach braking system should have been integrated with the locomotive’s controls. According to the railway order cited in reports, that arrangement was not functioning properly.

One loco pilot reported poor braking after departure and submitted a written complaint at Ranchi. Another driver subsequently raised concerns after taking over at Muri. Despite those warnings, the train continued until an inspection at Deen Dayal Upadhyaya station found that the brakes on every coach had been isolated.

The rake reportedly relied on the hauling locomotive’s brakes, including regenerative braking. This means it was not travelling with absolutely no braking capability, but its coaches were not contributing the braking force required for safe operation.

A November 7 order called for a detailed inquiry into maintenance checks, staff responses and crew actions. Preliminary findings identified failures across several levels.

The case raises a serious question for Indian Railways: why did repeated warnings fail to stop an unsafe movement? Advanced train technology still depends on correct preparation, effective inspections and prompt action when crews report trouble. The investigation must establish responsibility and identify safeguards that prevent similar lapses during future transfers.

snippet.title: Why '30 mins' Movie Scene Took 6 WHOLE YEARS To Make? Ramayana Movie's Jatayu Scene #shorts
snippet.description:
Six and a Half Years for One Battle: Ramayana’s Jatayu Sequence Reveals Massive VFX Effort

Director Nitesh Tiwari has revealed that the Ravana–Jatayu battle in Ranbir Kapoor’s Ramayana took six and a half years to complete, highlighting the extensive work behind one of the film’s major action sequences.

Speaking during a promotional interaction, Tiwari explained that the timeline covered everything from his initial briefing to the artists to the finished sequence. It represents the full development process, rather than six years of continuous filming. He said thousands of people contributed to creating the scene.

A major challenge was designing Ravana’s Pushpak Vimaan. The team explored approximately 40 to 50 designs over nearly two years before finalising its appearance. Changes to its structure also affected the battle choreography, requiring the filmmakers to rethink how Jatayu would approach and attack the flying vehicle.

Ranbir Kapoor praised the artists behind the visuals and expressed disappointment when audiences casually dismissed their work as AI-generated. He described a continuing review process in which the team examined individual shots and refined details, including clouds, contrast and depth.

The sequence also demanded careful voice work. Anupam Kher, who voices Jatayu, said watching the battle left him feeling unprepared to begin dubbing immediately. He returned the following day, taking additional time to understand the character’s emotions and his final interaction with Lord Rama.

For Indian audiences familiar with Jatayu’s attempt to rescue Sita, the revelation adds a production story to a deeply recognisable episode. It also brings attention to the artists whose years of work appear on screen within a single sequence.

snippet.title: How 800 Men Beat an Army of 100,000
snippet.description:
In 215, during China's Three Kingdoms era, the warlord Sun Quan marched on the small fortress of Hefei with an army said to number 100,000. Its commander, Zhang Liao, had about 7,000 men.
Before leaving for another campaign, his lord Cao Cao had left a sealed letter marked "Open when the enemy comes." When the enemy arrived, the letter ordered Zhang Liao and Li Dian to attack before the enemy army had fully gathered.
That night Zhang Liao picked 800 volunteers and gave them a feast. At dawn he broke through the barricades shouting his own name, fought his way to Sun Quan's banner and challenged him to come down from the hill he had retreated to. When the army surrounded him, he broke out, heard his trapped men calling for him, and charged back in to rescue them.
The attack broke the morale of Sun Quan's army. After failing to take Hefei, with sickness in his camp, Sun Quan withdrew, and Zhang Liao ambushed him at Xiaoyao Ford, where Sun Quan escaped only because his horse leapt a broken bridge.
Years later, Emperor Cao Pi wrote that Zhang Liao had defeated 100,000 with 800. In 222, when Zhang Liao was already ill, Sun Quan still warned his generals: "Zhang Liao may be ill, but he is still a foe to be reckoned with. Be careful!"

The scenes are our own drawings.

Sources: Chen Shou, Records of the Three Kingdoms (Sanguozhi), biography of Zhang Liao, with Pei Songzhi's notes; Wikipedia, "Battle of Xiaoyao Ford" and "Zhang Liao".

China’s 19-Seat Electric Plane Completes First Piloted Flight, Advancing Short-Distance Aviation

China has taken another step towards electric passenger aviation after the CE-25A completed its first piloted flight on November 14 in Binzhou, Shandong province. Developed by aircraft manufacturer COMAC with battery maker CATL, Shanghai Jiao Tong University and other partners, the aircraft carried two pilots and a flight-test engineer.

COMAC said the aircraft operated normally and met the expected performance indicators during the test. The CE-25A is the company’s first electric commercial aircraft, a distinction that should not be confused with being the world’s first electric plane.

Designed primarily for intercity travel, the aircraft can accommodate 19 passengers. Its published specifications include a maximum takeoff weight of 10 tonnes, a cruising speed of 300 kilometres per hour and a range of 400 kilometres. These figures position it as a potential option for shorter journeys between cities.

The latest flight follows months of testing. The CE-25A completed its first autonomous, uncrewed flight on February 2 and subsequently carried out 19 unmanned flight validations. China’s aviation regulator has accepted its application for a type certificate. 

However, accepting an application does not mean the aircraft has received approval to carry paying passengers. Commercial operations remain a future step, with certification still pending.

For India, the development raises an interesting question about the future of regional connectivity: could small electric aircraft eventually serve shorter routes between cities? This Chinese test does not establish an Indian launch timeline, but it provides a development to watch as aviation explores alternatives to conventional aircraft propulsion.

snippet.description:

My brother was sitting in my SUV with the radio blasting — holding my spare key. "Dad gave it to me."

One night her out-of-work brother Kyle is behind the wheel with the spare key Dad took from her kitchen drawer. When she takes it back, Dad doesn't side with her: "Then go find your own roof. Episode Info 👇
Show Name - Bokul- বকুল
Full Episode Number - 201

About the Serial:-
--------------------------

    Odity is a young educated woman grown up in an orphanage. Parent-identity-less Odity, by staying in the orphanage and studying, has now become a well-known doctor of the city. For Odity, the orphanage itself is everything; all her salary, every bit of money, she spends in the orphanage. The caretaker of the orphanage house, Kabita Baideu, sometimes says – “Don’t spend all your salary money only in the name of the orphanage, keep something for yourself too.” But Odity does not listen to her words; according to Odity, the orphanage made her into a selfsufficient woman, gave her a new identity, therefore whatever she does now will only be for the orphanage’s development.
 
      There is a famous businessman of the city named Anabil chaliha. He has many businesses, but his main business is buying land at cheap rates and selling it later at higher prices. He has two sons. The elder son, Nibedan, once lost his eyes because of his father’s mistake. From that day, simple and sincere Nibedan was seen differently by his father, who thought him weak and incapable of handling hardship. On the other hand, the younger son, aditya, is completely opposite. A reckless young man. There is a lot’s of love and affection between the two brothers. Though Nibedan cannot see with his own eyes, he sees the world through the vision of his brother. aditya never lets Nibedan feel his blindness — he takes him everywhere, introduces him to every little things, every environment, so that Nibedan never feels different. 

    One day, Anabil Chilha’s eyes fell on the land of the orphanage house. He tried every way to acquire it, but failed again and again. aditya also visited the orphanage and makes unnecessary noise there, and that is how he met Odity. Slowly, conflict between the two escalated. One day, Aditya was injured in an accident and was admitted to the hospital where Odity worked. The responsibility of treatment fell on Odity. At first, she treated him only out of duty, but gradually some small incidents changed her thoughts about Aditya. Their bond moved from enmity towards love. And later she became the daughter in law of Anabil chaliha. 

    Kalyani was the elder daughter-in-law of Anabil chaliha. Born into a Poor family, being an educated girl, she had married Nivedan under certain circumstances. She found it difficult to accept a blind young man as her husband. Though she always kept a smile on her face, inside she was restless, and she wanted to make Anabil Chilha’s wealth her own together with her brother. After Odity entered the family as Aditya’s beloved, Kalyani realized her dream would not be fulfilled. She began to suffer mental anguish. And One day, after many conspiracies she was able to thrown Odity out of the house. This incident increased the conflict between the two brothers. 

   Odity is now unable to return to the orphanage house because Anabil Chaliha made the land his own at the same time. The people of the ashram now misunderstood Odity because Odity is now Anabil Chaliha's daughter-in-law.  

   After the incident, Odity and Aditya left the house, and their mother tried hard to bring them back because of her love for her youngest son but without success. Meanwhile, Anabil Chaliha became an enemy to Odity. One day, he conspired together with a doctor from the same hospital to defame her and able fired her from her job. The slander was serious enough for her to get a job in a private nursing home also. Aditya mother helped them from time to time, but that was not enough. They both began their struggling lives. Despite being a doctor and the son of a wealthy businessman in the city, they continued their struggling lives by opening a small food stall on the sidewalk.

   After a long legal battle, one day she got her job back. A few days later, Anabil Chaliha suffered from a serious illness and Odity healed him. By then, Anabil chaliha and his wife slowly began to learn about Kalyani’s conspiracies. One day, they learn that kalyani is planning to kill Nibedan, so they throw her out of the house. They welcomed Aditya and Odity after realizing their mistake and eventually returned the land of the ashram. There is also a smile on the faces of the people of the ashram. A happy ending.

snippet.title: 介護職員が放火か「火をつければ行かなくていい」　週に1度訪問で間取りを熟知【報道ステーション】(2026年11月19日)
snippet.description:
先月17日、東京・豊島区でアパートが燃える火事がありました。この火事、放火とみられています。

アパートには、下半身に障害がある50代の男性が住んでいて、ほぼ寝たきりの状態だったそうです。

火事から1カ月。18日、捜査が動きました。

放火と殺人未遂の疑いで逮捕されたのは、介護職員の矢島隆容疑者（38）。部屋が燃えた障害がある男性の訪問介護を担当していました。

矢島容疑者は、訪問介護で、部屋の間取りまで熟知していました。

矢島隆容疑者
「ライターとスピリタスで火をつけた。大きな火事になれば、動けない被害者が死んでしまう可能性があることはわかっていた」

警視庁は、アルコール度数96度のウォッカとライターは、犯行当日に購入したとみています。

この炎の中に取り残されていたのは。

現場近くに住む人
「体が大きい人で、絶対に介護施設の協力がないと動けない。お風呂も入れない。お風呂を運んでいるのを見たことある」

矢島容疑者は、6年ほど、訪問介護の会社で働いていて、警視庁によりますと、今年6月から現場アパートに住む男性の介護を担当していたといいます。

矢島隆容疑者
「度々、叱責などを受けて悩んでいた。火をつければ、もう被害者のところに訪問しなくて良いと思った」

この火事で、下半身に障害がある男性は、重度の気道熱傷を負いました。気道のやけどは治りましたが、搬送された病院で、持病により亡くなったということです。
[テレ朝NEWS] https://news.tv-asahi.co.jp

El periodista Audelino Macario revela desde Tabasco los detalles de este golpe político al hijo del expresidente López Obrador.

Evaristo Hernández Cruz, delegado del Partido Verde en Tabasco y exalcalde de Villahermosa, confirmó que el Verde irá sin Morena en las elecciones de 2027 y que Andy López Beltrán no tiene influencia real en su estado natal. Mientras tanto, tres exgobernadores priistas, Roberto Madrazo, Manuel Andrade y Andrés Granier, se reunieron en Villahermosa para articular una oposición ciudadana contra Morena. Adela Micha analiza con Audelino Macario cómo el gobernador Javier May mantiene el control territorial y bloquea las aspiraciones del hijo del expresidente, incluyendo la candidatura de su amigo Daniel Casasús a la alcaldía del municipio de Centro.

snippet.description:
Watch the Ozzy Fox official trailer! 🦊👀 Meet Ozzy Fox, a five-year-old with BIG feelings and an even BIGGER imagination. Join Ozzy, Bitty, Mama, and Papa as they turn everyday routines into fun-filled music missions with catchy kids songs, creativity, and adventure.

Available on Disney+ December 5th 
https://www.disneyplus.com/whats-on

Watch the next video here: https://youtu.be/vAnV7BW8wp8

Watch Ozzy Fox on Disney Jr.! And check out more Ozzy Fox videos here: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLKQXT0dZRy5A

Ozzy Fox is a music-driven, short-form preschool series that transforms everyday routines and transitions into high-stakes, mission-based adventures, where the biggest obstacle isn't a monster... it's not wanting to stop the fun to do the thing.

Every story begins with five-year-old Ozzy mid-play, mid-dance, mid-very-important-kid-fueled-anything... when a daily routine brings everything to a halt! Enter Mama and Papa Fox, who creatively reframe the routine by leveling up the play. Together, they transform brushing teeth, cleaning up, saying goodbye, and bedtime into imaginative missions that help Ozzy move from "No way!" to "Mission accepted!"

Along for every adventure is Ozzy's baby sister, Bitty, a tiny chaos agent whose unpredictable innocence keeps everyone on their toes. She communicates through adorable giggles, claps, and expressive baby babble, often "helping" in ways only a toddler can. Whether she's accidentally creating problems, unwittingly solving them, or gleefully joining the fun, Bitty brings heart, humor, and delightful surprises to every mission.

Through original songs, playful family comedy, and imaginative gameplay, Ozzy Fox gives families simple, practical strategies they can use to help everyday routines feel more playful, more connected, and a whole lot more fun.

16:02 Մելսի և Բելայի հեռախոսազրույցը
